tenderSchedule.description: PREPARATION, SUPPLY, TRANSPORTATION AND SERVING OF BREAKFAST, LUNCH AND DINNER TO ARTISTS PARTICIPATING IN REHEARSALS AND JUMBO SAVARI IN CONNECTION WITH MYSURU DASARA MAHOTSAVA 2026

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder shall be a registered catering agency / hotel / food service provider / firm / company capable of undertaking large-scale catering
Adequate kitchen, vehicles, manpower, utensils, packing and food handling facilities. details of the photographs and lease documents to be submitted
The successful bidder shall deploy at least one FoSTaC-trained and certified Food Safety Supervisor during the contract period
Ability to supply food simultaneously to multiple accommodation rehearsal centers undertaking to submitted

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Average/required turnover shall be not less than twice the estimated tender amount, i.e. 70.00 lakh, as prescribed
Bank Solvency Certificate for minimum 30 percent of estimated tender amount, i.e. 10.50 lakh
Bidder shall be a registered catering agency / hotel / food service provider / firm / company capable of undertaking large-scale catering
Bidder shall not have been blacklisted/debarred by any Government Department/ULB/PSU
Capacity to prepare and supply not less than 5,000 plates/meals per day and to cater to the entire tender requirement within stipulated timings
Minimum 1 year experience in preparation and supply of food/catering services
Valid FSSAI Licence appropriate to the catering activity
